nodes.label: Bug Category A: ViewModel Lifecycle / ShellContent Cache
nodes.rationale: Symptom: previous user's data appears in new user session. Diagnosis: page is ShellContent and VM captures Preferences in constructor. Fix: move to RegisterRoute.

nodes.label: Bug Category B: Async Race Condition — Preferences Not Updated Before Navigation
nodes.rationale: Symptom: next screen reads UserId/CoachId/ExperienceLevelId from previous user. Diagnosis: fire-and-forget task writes Preferences, navigation happens before task completes. Fix: synchronous Preferences.Set + await before GoToAsync.

nodes.label: Bug Category F: Cached ShellContent Not Reinitializing
nodes.rationale: Symptom: returning to screen shows stale data. Diagnosis: ShellContent ViewModel lacks AppearingAsync + _isInitialized pattern. Fix: add _isInitialized guard, add Reset() for logout.
